# View-rotation fixture provenance

`view-rotation-quarter-turn.json` is an original six-pixel orientation fixture
created for Chromarchy. Its asymmetric 2×3 color grid independently specifies
the expected 3×2 result of a clockwise display-only quarter turn. It contains
no third-party image, product asset, UI expression, or proprietary behavior.

The fixture defines viewport orientation only. The document dimensions, sparse
pixel blocks, composite bytes, history, modified state, and native format remain
unchanged by view rotation.
